name: Coulomb friction model
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 以法向压力及摩擦系数限制切向接触力的摩擦模型。
usage_note: 文中用于指定接触界面，其系数0.3仅是该界面计算条件。

complete_examples.text: In the model of P-PRBT, the interaction between the PRBT blocks and the ballast is set to be ‘surface to surface contact’, the normal contact is set as ‘Hard Contact’, while the Coulomb friction model with a friction coefficient of 0.3 is adopted as the tangential contact [42].
